title: Bruma
description: **Bruma** is an educational Game Boy and Game Boy Color emulator built from scratch in `Rust` to understand how these systems work at the hardware and software level. The project involved implementing core components such as the *CPU, memory, instruction set,* and graphics system, resulting in a functional emulator capable of running several commercial games.
extendedDescription:
**Bruma** is an educational Game Boy and Game Boy Color emulator written entirely in `Rust`, built from scratch to explore how these systems work at the hardware and software level.
The project involved studying the consoles' *CPU, memory, instruction set, graphics hardware,* and *timing behavior*, then translating those specifications into a working emulator. Bruma currently has a functional release capable of running several commercial games, including **Mega Man 5, Bomberman, Pokémon Crystal,** and **Pokémon Yellow**.
